route: /style-board/ (the style board: module contactChannels:cards, longest and shortest copy, photos as grey frames)

findings.issue: This was reported before and is still not fixed: on phones the four channel cards stack one per row at full width. Each card is a tall, mostly empty box holding one small icon, an oversized label bar (1.25rem bold) and one line of text, so the section runs to about 880 px. The cause is reference.css line 483, `@media (max-width: 599px) { .contact-channels[data-variant="cards"] > .contact-channel { flex-basis: 100%; } }`.
findings.reference: The competitor keeps its channel cards as compact outlined tiles on phones, two by two (components.md, contact section 3; the mobile shot shows the four tiles side by side). Each tile has an icon over a black label bar.
findings.fix: In src/styles/reference.css line 483, change flex-basis: 100% to flex-basis: calc(50% - var(--grid-gap) / 2) with min-width: 0 so the cards sit two by two. Add overflow-wrap: anywhere to the card's value text so the email address breaks inside a half-width card. Below 600px, bring .contact-channels[data-variant="cards"] .contact-channel__name down to about 1rem with 0.375rem 0.75rem padding so the label bar fits the smaller tile.

findings.issue: This was reported before and is still not fixed: the parts of the cards in the one row do not line up. The email and phone links sit about 5 px lower under their label bars than the plain address and hours text (y≈200 against y≈195 on the shot).
findings.reference: The competitor's channel cards put their icon, label bar and text at the same heights across the row.
findings.fix: In src/styles/reference.css, give the linked value (a[href]) and the plain-text value inside .contact-channels[data-variant="cards"] .contact-channel the same box: the same display, line-height, padding and margin, with no extra block padding or min-height on the link. Then the line under every label bar starts at one height.

findings.issue: The channel icons are small, thin line glyphs, about 24 px across, floating in the card's top band. The icon reads much weaker than the black label bar under it, and the top of each card looks empty.
findings.reference: The competitor's channel cards lead with a large icon, about 60–70 px across and often set in a round badge, centred above the label bar, so the icon carries the card.
findings.fix: In src/styles/reference.css, raise --channel-icon-size (and --channel-icon-box) for .contact-channels[data-variant="cards"] to about 2.5rem on desktop. Keep the line-icon style and stroke colour; on phones, the box can keep following the icon size as it does now.
